items.title: 3.3.2 Valence shell electron pair repulsion model (VSEPR) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.3.2, printed pages 52-58.

blocks.text: VSEPR model molecules ki shaklein darmiyani atom ke gird electron pairs se bayan karta hai. Ise Sidgwick aur Powell ne 1940 mein pesh kiya aur yeh is mafrooze par qaim hai ke molecule woh shakal leta hai jis mein darmiyani atom ke valence electrons ke darmiyan barqi dhakel (electronic repulsions) kam se kam ho. Kam se kam dhakel ke liye electron pairs apne aap ko zyada se zyada mumkin faslon par tarteeb dete hain, aur yehi tarteeb molecule ki geometry tai karti hai.
Mafroozat (postulates)

items: Lone pairs (ghair-bandhe) aur bond pairs dono molecules ki geometries tai karne mein hissa lete hain.
Electron pairs darmiyani atom ke gird is tarah tarteeb pate hain ke zyada se zyada fasle par rahein aur dhakel se bachein.

Lone pairs ke electrons bond pairs se zyada jagah lete hain, to ghair-bandhe pairs bandhe hue pairs par zyada dhakelne wali quwwat lagate hain aur unhen dabate hain. Dhakel is tarteeb mein ghatti hai: lone pair-lone pair > lone pair-bond pair > bond pair-bond pair. Do nuclei ka baanta hua electron pair ek nucleus se bandhe lone pair se kam jagah leta hai.
Double bond ke do electron pairs aur triple bond ke teen zyada charge density rakhte hain, magar unhen ek pair gina jata hai.
Darmiyani atom ke saath bohat electronegative atoms bond pairs ke darmiyan dhakel kam karte hain, magar lone pair ki dhakel mazboot.

blocks.alt: Do khaakon ki patti. Baen: atom X aur atom H, darmiyan mein lamba patla electron badal (bond pair). Daen: atom X, ek taraf chaura gol electron badal (lone pair), jo bond pair ke badal se saaf mota hai.
blocks.caption: Do nuclei mein baanta electron jora ek nucleus se bandhe lone pair se kam jagah leta hai (kitab mein mafroozat ke oopar chhapi patti ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bond pair ka electron badal do nuclei (X aur H) ke darmiyan khincha hua aur patla hai, kyunke dono nuclei use pakarte hain. Lone pair sirf ek nucleus (X) se bandha hai, is liye phail kar zyada jagah leta hai. Isi wajah se lone pair bond pairs ko zyada dhakelta hai aur zawiye chhote ho jate hain.
Molecules ki shaklon ka andaza

Darmiyani atom ka naam A aur us ke gird electron pairs B rakhe jate hain, jo A ki valency ke mutabiq AB2, AB3, AB4 waghaira qism ke molecules dete hain. Electron pair geometry A ke gird kul electron pairs ki tadaad se tai hoti hai, jabke molecule ki asal shakal atoms se, lone pairs ko chhor kar. Qadam yeh hain: darmiyani atom chunein, aam taur par sab se kam electronegative atom ya sab se kam atoms wala unsur (CCl4 mein carbon); us ke gird electron pairs ginein, bond pairs aur lone pairs (CCl4 mein chaar bond pairs aur koi lone pair nahi); table se electron pair geometry parhein (chaar pairs, tetrahedral); phir lone pairs chhor kar shakal batayein.

blocks.caption: Covalent bandhe hue compounds ki geometries aur shaklein (Table 3.1)

blocks.text: AB2, AB3 aur AB4 qismein
AB2 molecules mein do electron pairs 180 degrees par hote hain, linear geometry: BeCl2 mein beryllium darmiyani atom hai jis ke do bond pairs aur koi lone pair nahi.

blocks.alt: Baen: Cl-Be-Cl seedhi lakeer mein, Be ke oopar muRa dohra teer, 180 degrees likha. Daen: ball-and-stick model, do bari neeli Cl gendein chhoti laal Be gend ke zariye seedh mein juri.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.9: BeCl2 molecule ki seedhi (linear) shakal (kitab ki Figure 3.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: AB3 molecules mein teen electron pairs 120 degrees par, trigonal geometry: BF3 trigonal planar hai jis ka har F-B-F zawiya 120 degrees hai, aur group 13 ke hydrides, AlH3, GaH3 aur BH3, se bhi yehi mutawaqqa hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: darmiyan mein B, teen F atoms se jura, ek oopar aur do neeche, do F atoms ke darmiyan muRa dohra teer, 120 degrees. Daen: ball model, bari laal B gend aur tikon ke konon par teen chhoti neeli gendein.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.10: BF3 ek AB3 system hai jis ki tikoni musattah (trigonal planar) geometry hai (kitab ki Figure 3.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: SnCl2 mein tin atom ke chaar bairooni electrons hain; woh do bonds banata hai aur baqi do lone pair ke taur par rakhta hai jo tikon ka ek kona leta hai, jo bukharat (vapour) mein bigri hui trigonal electron pair geometry aur 120 degrees se kam zawiye wala v-shaped molecule deta hai. Multiple bonds ke saath, SO3 ke teenon ilaqe S=O bonds se bhare hain aur woh 120 degrees par bilkul trigonal hai, jabke SO2 mein ek kone par lone pair aur baqi do par double bond hai, to woh SnCl2 ki tarah mura hua hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: SO3, darmiyan mein S aur tikon ke konon par O atoms se teen S=O double bonds, ek zawiya 120 degrees. Daen: SO2, S ke oopar do laal nuqton wala lone pair lobe aur neeche do S=O bonds; O-S-O zawiya 'Less than 120 degrees' likha.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.12: Multiple bonds wale SO2 aur SO3 ki shaklein (kitab ki Figure 3.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: AB4 molecules mein chaar electron pairs ek doosre se bachne ke liye ba-qaida tetrahedron ke kone lete hain, 109.5 degrees ke bond zawiyon ke saath. Methane mein carbon ke chaar valence electrons mein se har ek hydrogen atom ke akele electron se jora banata hai, aur chaar bond pairs tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain, ghair-musattah (non-planar) tarteeb; har H-C-H zawiya 109.5 degrees hai, aur SiH4, GeH4 aur CCl4 ki shakal wahi hai. Tetrahedron ke chaar kone, chaar chehre, chhe kinare aur chhe bond zawiye hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: methane ka ball-and-stick model, kaali C gend neele khaake wale tetrahedron ke konon par chaar halki neeli H gendon se juri. Daen: CH4 ki lakeeri tasveer, C chaar H atoms se jura, H atoms dashed lakeeron se tetrahedron banate hain, H-C-H zawiya 109.5 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.13: CH4 molecule ki ba-qaida tetrahedral shakal (kitab ki Figure 3.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ammonia mein nitrogen ke gird teen atoms aur ek lone pair hain; lone pair misali 109.5 degrees ko 107 degrees kar deta hai aur molecule trigonal pyramid hai. Hydrogen ki jagah electronegative atoms zawiya aur kam karte hain: NF3 mein zawiye 102.5 degrees tak dabte hain, kyunke N-F bond ki shadeed polarity nitrogen ko lone pair qareeb khinchne deti hai, jo bonding electrons ko zyada dhakelta hai, aur kyunke bond pairs fluorine atoms ke qareeb hain, jo un ki aapas ki dhakel kamzor karta hai.

blocks.alt: NH3 ki teen tasweerein. Baen: tetrahedron, darmiyan mein N, teen konon par H gendein aur oopar wale kone par do nuqton wala lone pair lobe. Darmiyan: pyramid shakal ka ball model, N teen H atoms ke oopar. Daen: wedge-aur-dash tasveer, N aur teen H, H atoms dashed lakeeron se jure, aur teer H-N-H zawiye ki taraf, 107 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.14: NH3 molecule ki bigri hui geometry aur pyramid shakal (kitab ki Figure 3.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Pani chaar electron pairs ke saath v-shaped hai, jin mein do lone pairs tetrahedron ke do konon par hain; un ki zyada dhakel zawiya 104.5 degrees kar deti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen, 'Tetrahedral geometry including lone pairs' likha: tetrahedron mein laal O gend, neeche ke do konon par H gendein aur do lone pair lobes, har ek mein do nuqte, oopar aur neeche. Daen, 'Angular shape of water molecule excluding lone pairs' likha: H2O ka mura hua ball model aur H-O-H lakeeri tasveer, zawiya 104.5 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.15: Pani ke molecule ke do lone pairs hain aur woh dabe hue bond zawiye ke saath v-shaped hai (kitab ki Figure 3.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani mein chaar electron pairs hain: do bond pairs aur do lone pairs, jo tetrahedron ke konon par hain (geometry). Shakal sirf atoms se dekhi jati hai, lone pairs chhor kar, is liye molecule mura hua (angular) hai. Do lone pairs ki zyada dhakel zawiye ko 109.5 se 104.5 degrees tak daba deti hai.

Ions bhi inhi qaidon par chalte hain: hydronium ion H3O+, jo pani ke proton pakarne se banta hai, ek lone pair wala AB4 hai aur ammonia ki tarah trigonal pyramidal; amide ion NH2- ke do lone pairs aur do bond pairs hain, tetrahedral geometry aur pani jaisi muri hui (v) shakal.

blocks.alt: Chaar hisse. 'Hydronium ion': laal lone pair electrons wala pani ka molecule, lone pair se H+ ki taraf muRa teer, aur neeche H3O+ ki Lewis structure, ek lone pair aur + charge. 'Tetrahedral electron pair geometry': tetrahedron mein O, teen H gendein aur oopar lone pair lobe. 'Trigonal pyramidal shape': O gend teen H gendon ke oopar. 'V-shaped amide ion': N, do hare lone pair lobes aur H se do bonds 104.1 degrees par, chakor brackets mein, minus charge.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.16: Hydronium (H3O+) aur amide (NH2-) ions ki shaklein (kitab ki Figure 3.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: AB5 aur AB6 qismein

AB5 molecules mein paanch electron pairs trigonal bipyramid ke konon par phailte hain: teen jagahein musattah tikon mein aur do plane ke amood mehwar par, jaise PCl5 mein, plane ke andar 120 degrees aur mehwari (axial) aur musattah atom ke darmiyan 90 degrees ke zawiyon ke saath.

blocks.alt: PCl5 ki teen tasweerein. Baen: Lewis structure, P paanch Cl atoms se jura, har Cl par teen lone pairs. Darmiyan: dotted trigonal bipyramid ke andar laal P gend ke gird paanch surmai electron pair lobes. Daen: ball-and-stick model, laal P gend aur paanch hari Cl gendein, do khare mehwar par aur teen beech mein gird.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.17: PCl5 molecule ki Lewis structure aur shakal (kitab ki Figure 3.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yahan lone pairs shakal zyada dramaai taur par badalte hain. Tri-iodide ion I3- linear hai halanke woh AB5 system hai: darmiyani iodine ke paanch pairs hain, do bond pairs aur teen lone pairs, to us ki geometry trigonal bipyramidal hai; lone pairs tikon ke teen kone lete hain aur do iodine atoms plane ke oopar aur neeche ki chotiyan, aur lone pairs chhor kar shakal linear hai jis mein iodine atoms 180 degrees par hain.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein laal iodine gend, khari chhaRi par us ke bilkul oopar aur neeche do iodine gendein, aur beech mein teen surmai lone pair lobes, ek baen aur do daen. Baen taraf aadhe daire ki qaus oopar aur neeche ke iodine atoms ko milati hai, 180 degrees likha.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.18: Tri-iodide ion ([I3]-) ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 3.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: AB6 molecules mein chhe electron pairs octahedral geometry lete hain, chaar musattah murabbe ke konon par aur do amood mehwar par, sab zawiye 90 degrees, jaise SF6 mein.

blocks.alt: SF6 ki teen tasweerein. Baen: Lewis structure, S chhe F atoms se jura, har F par teen lone pairs. Darmiyan: octahedral ball-and-stick model, peeli S gend chhe hari F gendon se juri, octahedron ke dashed kinare. Daen: wedge-aur-dash tasveer, S ke oopar aur neeche F, do hashed bonds peeche aur do wedge bonds aage, do zawiye 90 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.19: SF6 ki Lewis structure aur octahedral shakal, har zawiya 90 degrees (kitab ki Figure 3.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: XeF4 chaar bond pairs aur do lone pairs wala AB6 hai; lone pairs 180 degrees par sab se door rehte hain, aur unhen chhor kar shakal square planar hai jis ke sab zawiye 90 degrees hain.

blocks.alt: XeF4 ki teen tasweerein. Baen: Lewis structure, Xe par do lone pairs aur chaar F atoms se jura, har F par teen lone pairs. Darmiyan: narangi Xe gend ke gird chaar hari F gendein aur do neele lone pair lobes oopar aur neeche, qaus ke saath 'lone pair is farthest at 180 degrees' likha. Daen: square planar ball model, chaar F atoms ke dashed murabbe ke beech Xe, ek zawiya 90 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.20: XeF4 ki Lewis structure aur square planar shakal (kitab ki Figure 3.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: XeF4 mein Xe ke gird chhe pairs hain: chaar bond pairs aur do lone pairs. Dono lone pairs ek doosre se sab se door, 180 degrees par, yaani oopar aur neeche rehte hain. Chaar F atoms beech ke musattah murabbe mein reh jate hain, is liye shakal square planar hai aur har F-Xe-F zawiya 90 degrees hai.

blocks.prompt: SiH4, H2Se aur PH3 mein bond pairs aur lone pairs ginein, un ki shaklon aur zawiyon ka andaza lagayein, aur batayein ke H2S ka zawiya H2O se kaise mukhtalif hai.
blocks.explanation: SiH4: chaar bond pairs, koi lone pair nahi, tetrahedral, 109.5 degrees. PH3: teen bond pairs aur ek lone pair, trigonal pyramidal, 109.5 degrees se thora kam. H2Se: do bond pairs aur do lone pairs, v-shaped, 109.5 degrees se kaafi kam. H2S, H2Se ki tarah, v-shaped hai, magar us ka zawiya pani ke 104.5 degrees se chhota hai (taqreeban 92 degrees) kyunke sulfur ke bare orbitals aur mazboot lone pair dhakel bonds ko qareeb dhakelte hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: VSEPR (Sidgwick aur Powell, 1940): darmiyani atom ke gird electron pairs zyada se zyada door rehte hain; lone pairs geometry ke liye ginte hain, shakal ke liye nahi, aur sab se zyada dhakelte hain (lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp); multiple bonds ek pair ginte hain.

AB2 linear 180; AB3 trigonal 120 (ek lone pair: v-shaped, SnCl2, SO2); AB4 tetrahedral 109.5 (NH3 107, NF3 102.5, H2O 104.5; H3O+ pyramidal, NH2- mura); AB5 trigonal bipyramidal 120 aur 90 (I3- teen lone pairs ke saath linear); AB6 octahedral 90 (XeF4 do lone pairs ke saath square planar).
